en.askTitle: Swap in your own products, prices and costs and get the same Etsy, Big Cartel and Shopify comparison
en.runTitle: Bristol: a home candle maker choosing where to sell online from January 2027

fields.label: Products
fields.value: Hand-poured soy candles made at home

fields.label: Prices and candles per order
fields.value: £18 per candle at markets; an online order averages about £26, roughly 1.4 candles plus postage

fields.label: Delivery charge and packed parcel weights
fields.value: Royal Mail, about 500g per candle parcel

fields.label: Materials, labour and packaging costs
fields.placeholder: e.g. £3.20 of wax, wick and fragrance per candle, plus £0.90 packaging

fields.label: Monthly market and online sales
fields.value: About 60 candles a month at markets; online from January 2027, expecting around 120 online orders a month by the end of 2027

fields.label: Direct-customer sources
fields.placeholder: e.g. market regulars, an Instagram following, a mailing list

en.template: Compare Etsy, Big Cartel and Shopify for my {location}, {products}, {prices}, {delivery}, {costs}, {cards}, {sales}, {direct} and {vat}. Separate fees from profit, include acquisition costs and check the applicable safety and dated pricing requirements. Give me a launch choice and the conditions for changing it. Plan only; do not open accounts, contact anyone, subscribe or pay.

phases.title: Read the official platform fee pages, Royal Mail prices and UK candle rules
phases.note: Etsy fees, postage, labelling, product safety and VAT
phases.judgment: Where sources disagreed, it said so instead of picking one. Royal Mail’s headline prices clashed with its dated October price guides, so it modelled with the dated tables (2nd Class £4.40/£4.60). It also found that the government’s October 2026 standards notice leaves out the candle standards that local-authority guidance calls designated, and did not promise automatic legal protection.

phases.title: Build the comparison page and an editable workbook with every calculation visible
phases.judgment: The independent colleague checked all 158 workbook formulas and 75 numbers on the page, with zero mismatches, confirmed that postage is charged once per order, and caught one leftover: some comparison labels stayed fixed at “20%” and “12%” when the assumptions were edited.

phases.title: Independent check of the arithmetic, workbook recalculation and phone and desktop tests
phases.judgment: The hand-over lists what it could not confirm: January 2027 postage tariffs, Etsy’s exact set-up and currency charges, real packaging costs, and how Shopify’s UK subscription is taxed.

workers: Read the official UK rules on candle labelling, product safety, safety standards and VAT
Checked Etsy’s current UK fees and Royal Mail’s current prices for a roughly 500g candle parcel
Independently recalculated the workbook and the page, and sampled the original fee sources
